Relationship Workbench

One customer, one financial institution, many facilities - scorecard to structured decision record. Runs entirely in this file: customer data never leaves the browser.

NCGCL Relationship Workbench v1.3 · model 1.5.0 · calibration CAL-2026-11-03 · built 03 Nov 2026. Calculation and approval are separate: nothing here approves a guarantee, a price or a limit. Output is only as good as its inputs; the PD / LGD / capital parameters flagged as Model priors or class C/U need independent challenge before reliance. No network requests are made; drafts are stored in this browser only.
